facts.text: The Job Placement Guarantee ensures all undergraduate students will receive a job offer or graduate school acceptance within six months of graduation.

sources.title: Job Placement Guarantee - The University of Tulsa
sources.quote: The University of Tulsa guarantees that within six months of graduation, you WILL receive a job offer or be accepted into graduate school! As part of The University of Tulsa's commitment to excellence, the Job Placement Guarantee (JPG) program has expanded to now include ALL University of Tulsa undergraduate students.
